recognize_zh: 高倍EBER原位雜交可見大小不一的細胞核呈深藍色陽性，包括中小型淋巴球與較大的免疫母細胞，陽性細胞零散分布於紅色對比染色背景中，是EBV再活化的典型表現。
features: Dark blue nuclear EBER signal in scattered cells (chromogenic ISH, red counterstain)
Positive cells include small-to-intermediate lymphocytes and larger immunoblast-sized nuclei
Variable signal intensity from faint to strong
Positive cells dispersed, not forming sheets; a vascular space crosses the field
describe_en: High-power EBER in situ hybridization shows scattered nuclei with blue EBER signal of variable intensity in a red-counterstained background. The positive cells span a range of sizes, from small lymphocytes to larger immunoblasts, and are dispersed individually adjacent to a vascular space. The presence of numerous EBER-positive cells across a spectrum of sizes supports an EBV-driven reactive lymphoid proliferation (EBV reactivation).

ddx.vs: EBER positivity in cHL is essentially confined to large HRS cells, whereas here many small cells are also positive.
ENKTL shows EBER in nearly all atypical cells with angiocentric destruction and necrosis, rather than a subset of scattered cells.

ddx.dx: Chronic active EBV disease / EBV+ T/NK LPD
ddx.vs: These require clinical persistence and demonstration of EBV in T or NK cells by double staining, which cannot be determined from EBER alone.
